title: Rain, late
note: A narrow street on a rainy night: shop windows and lamps in amber and red, long reflections on wet cobbles, three figures with umbrellas walking away. Oil and palette knife on toned canvas. Written by paintings/rain.gen.mjs.

veil.note: thin transparent colour scrubbed onto the canvas first

scrub.note: paint thinned with turpentine for the block-in: little body, it stays wet

paint.note: the dark body paint: glossy enough that the lamp finds its ridges

stiff.note: paint straight from the tube for knife work

thin.note: thinned paint for the sky: smooth, little relief

slab.note: knife paint for walls and sky: less body than the lights, so the darks do not turn to stucco

figure.note: the figures: dark, matt enough to read as a silhouette, burying what is beneath

clean.note: accents that must stay clean: no merging into what is beneath

lamp glass.note: the glass of a lantern: a glossy bead of the brightest paint

iron.note: black iron of the lamp posts

broad.note: a big hog flat for the block-in

scumble.note: nearly dry, so that it catches only the tooth and the ridges

knife dry.note: a knife dragged thin: it skips across the ridges beneath

steps.name: Toned ground and drawing
steps.note: A transparent scrub of warm sienna where the lights will be and violet in the dark, then the perspective drawn with thin umber.

steps.name: Sky
steps.note: Deep blue-violet scrubbed in with a big brush in crossing diagonals, a few dark knife slabs, paling toward the glow at the end of the street.

steps.name: Facades
steps.note: The two walls blocked in along the lines of the street, dark above and warmed from below by the lamps and windows; the glow round each lamp worked in wet.

steps.name: Windows, cornices, doors
steps.note: The upper windows (dark, a few lit), cornices catching the light from below, doors, shop fronts and the red awning.

steps.name: Street, wet
steps.note: The road and pavements blocked in with horizontal strokes, then the reflections dragged down into them while all of it is wet.

steps.name: Cobbles
steps.note: Each sett a rounded dab of stiff paint, lit along its top and dark beneath, coloured by what the wet stone mirrors there.

steps.name: Shop windows
steps.note: The glow inside each window laid in wet: dim and red at the edges, gold toward the lamp inside, with the shapes of shelves and a shopkeeper melting into it.

steps.name: Window bars
steps.note: Dark glazing bars over the dry glow, a warm edge on each frame.

steps.name: Lamp posts
steps.note: Iron posts and lanterns, and the bracket lamp on the right; the halo round each light scumbled on dry.

steps.name: Figures
steps.note: Three people under umbrellas walking away into the glow (their reflections are already in the wet road).

steps.name: Reflections, thick
steps.note: The long reflections of the lamps and windows: short drags of a loaded knife that skips over the cobbles, densest near the mirrored light; bright touches where they are strongest.

steps.name: The lights
steps.note: Lantern glass in thick enamel-bright paint, the window centres pushed hotter, the lit fanlights.

steps.name: Rain
steps.note: The rain: fine slanting streaks, lit warm where they fall through the light; splashes in the reflections.
